description: This file contains the definition of the class Opencart.Admin.Model.Design.SeoUrl, which manages SEO URLs within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving SEO URL entries from the database, supporting filtering and querying by key, value, store ID, and language ID.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Represents SEO URL management logic for the OpenCart admin design module, facilitating CRUD operations and complex retrievals related to SEO-friendly URLs in different store views and languages.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL into the database with specified key, value, keyword, store ID, language ID, and sort order. Returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL identified by seo_url_id with new key, value, keyword, store ID, language ID, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes a SEO URL record based on its seo_url_id.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URLs that match specific key and value pairs, optionally filtered by store ID and language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all SEO URLs associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all SEO URLs associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Fetches a single SEO URL record by its seo_url_id.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves an SEO URL record matching given key and value, filtered by store ID and language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Fetches SEO URL data where the keyword matches, filtered by store ID and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SEO URLs, optionally filtered by provided criteria such as keyword, key, value, store ID, language ID, and supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Returns an array of SEO URLs grouped by store and language, matching specific key and value criteria.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Fetches all SEO URLs associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all SEO URLs associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO URL entries, supporting filters by keyword, key, value, store ID, and language ID.
